description: An interior view of the Abiquiu studio with O’Keeffe sitting in profile, hair pulled back in a bun, wearing a black suit looking in the direction of Juan Hamilton who sits back in a chair with his hands over his head. Next to him is one of O’Keeffe’s chows and Lucille Webb, who is sitting back in a chair with her legs crossed at her knees with her black purse on the floor. Behind O’Keeffe’s head is one of her paintings of the Black Place.
title: Abiquiu, N.M.
